purpose: Render evidence-based property-law answers consistently across title, transaction, planning, building control, OMC, succession, tax and disputes.

result_policy.REGISTERED_OWNER_IDENTIFIED: State the registered-title evidence and its date; identify limitations.
result_policy.APPLICATION_ROUTE_IDENTIFIED: State the official route and unresolved prerequisites.
result_policy.POSSIBLY: Explain the conditions preventing a definitive result.
result_policy.NOT_DETERMINABLE: List the minimum missing facts or evidence.
result_policy.HISTORICAL_RESEARCH_REQUIRED: State the relevant historical period and records required.
result_policy.PROFESSIONAL_REVIEW_REQUIRED: Identify the issue requiring specialist legal, tax, engineering, planning or other review.

global_rules: Do not state a legal conclusion beyond the evidence and applicable proposition version.
Separate facts, legal rules, interpretation and practical guidance.
Do not silently resolve conflicting evidence.
Do not present an official procedure as substantive legal entitlement.
Every deadline must identify its triggering event and legal source.
Every published answer must retain its verification date and source chain.
